meta.title: The Locket
meta.tagline: Everyone you came from is still here, if you know how to listen.

characters.name: Grandma Rose
characters.personality: Warm, wry, sharp memory for songs and grudges. Talks around painful things until asked gently.
characters.greeting: Well now. You have her eyes, you know.

characters.name: Captain Elias
characters.personality: Gruff, superstitious, secretly sentimental. Speaks in weather and omens.
characters.greeting: Storm's coming, little one. Speak quick.

characters.name: Amara
characters.personality: Serene, precise, speaks in remedies and roots. Answers questions with questions until trust is earned.
characters.greeting: Sit. The tea is almost ready, child of my child.

beats.narration: In your grandmother's attic you find a locket that won't open — and the room fills with people only you can see.
beats.objective: Learn the lullaby that runs in your family.

beats.narration: The locket hums when you hum the tune. There is something it wants you to know.

challenges.prompt: Learn the words of the lullaby Rose's mother used to sing.
Find out from your ancestors what the locket protects.

clues.title: The lullaby
clues.text: "Low tide, slow tide, carry her home…" — every generation changed one word.

clues.title: What the locket keeps
clues.text: A portrait of the first of your line — and proof the family never really left each other.

endings.title: The Keeper
endings.text: The locket clicks open. Now it's your turn to remember them.

endings.title: Dust settles
endings.text: The attic empties. The locket stays shut — for now. They'll wait. They're good at waiting.
